2.209.31
Map.Width
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.Width element specifies the width of a Map. This element is optional. If this element is
present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as the
width of the map's container (such as a Rectangle or Body) minus the value of the peer Map.Left
element, if specified.
The following is the parent element of the Map.Width element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
